 Jacob Fearnley v Hugo Gaston
 H2H: First Meeting
 BRUSSELS, BELGIUM – Jacob Fearnley is looking for match confidence as he takes on Hugo Gaston in his opening round match in Brussels.

 Jacob Fearnley will be hoping he can gain some more wins before the season ends and starts his Brussels campaign with a winnable contest against Hugo Gaston .

 Fearnley will be looking to be aggressive on serve as he knows any short second serves will be punished by Gaston.
 Playing styles and prediction
 Gaston has had a good second half to the season with some deep Challenger tour runs as well as qualifying for the US Open. The Frenchman has a unique style of play and has been extremely efficient on return this year. Gaston will hope that form continues as he looks for a crucial victory ahead of the final few tournaments of the season.
 Fearnley will be looking for aggressive first serves while getting his forehand into play at the earliest opportunity. Meanwhile, Gaston will use the backhand to open up the court and will be aggressive on the second serve return. This is a crucial match for Fearnley if he wants to end the season on a positive note and the Brit will edge to victory after a nervy start.
 Prediction: Fearnley in three sets.
